title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1 Business（客户集中度段落）
key_points: FY2022（截至 2022-12-31 财年）有一个客户占 AMD 合并净收入（consolidated net revenue）的 16%。
该客户的销售来自公司 Gaming 分部。
10-K 明确表述失去该客户将对公司业务产生重大不利影响（material adverse effect）。
该披露位于 Item 1 Business 正文中，紧接在描述与客户共同开发差异化产品、收取非经常性工程费用（non-recurring engineering fees）的段落后，位于 Original Equipment Manufacturers 小节之前。
raw_excerpt: One customer accounted for 16% of our consolidated net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022. Sales to this customer consisted of sales of products from our Gaming segment. A loss of this customer would have a material adverse effect on our business.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — NOTE 10 Concentrations of Credit Risk
key_points: Note 10 标题为「Concentrations of Credit Risk」，讨论时间存款、可供出售债务证券与应收账款（trade receivables）的信用风险集中。
截至 2022-12-31，一个客户约占合并应收账款余额（total consolidated accounts receivable balance）的 18%。
截至 2021-12-25，两个客户分别约占合并应收账款余额的 20% 和 15%。
公司称应收账款信用风险集中度有限，理由是客户群数量大且地域分散（a large number of geographically diverse customers）。
公司基于过往收款经验与当前信用质量评估，认为这些客户的应收余额不构成重大信用风险。
raw_excerpt: NOTE 10 – Concentrations of Credit Risk … The Company believes that concentrations of credit risk with respect to trade receivables are limited because a large number of geographically diverse customers make up the Company's customer base, thus diluting the trade credit risk. One customer accounted for approximately 18% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 31, 2022. Two customers each accounted for approximately 20% and 15% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 25, 2021.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1A Risk Factors（风险因素摘要列表）
key_points: Item 1A Risk Factors 的「Risk Factors Summary」列表中，Economic and Strategic Risks 类别下设有专门条目：The loss of a significant customer may have a material adverse effect on us.
该条目与 Intel 主导地位、全球经济不确定性、半导体行业周期性等风险并列，属于公司自认的主要风险之一。
raw_excerpt: ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS … Risk Factors Summary … Economic and Strategic Risks … • The loss of a significant customer may have a material adverse effect on us.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1A Risk Factors 正文（客户付款风险段落）
key_points: Item 1A 正文指出，公司预期少数客户（a small number of customers）将持续占其收入的很大一部分（a substantial part of our revenue）。
公司据此认为客户违约或延迟支付应收账款的风险被放大。
raw_excerpt: The risk related to our customers potentially defaulting on or delaying payments to us is increased because we expect that a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of our revenue.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 MD&A: FY2022 第二季度起变更报告分部（口径变化）
key_points: During the second quarter of fiscal year 2022, AMD changed its reporting segments to align financial reporting with how it manages the business in strategic end markets.
AMD reports performance based on four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.
The change is described as consistent with how the Chief Operating Decision Maker assesses financial performance and allocates resources.
raw_excerpt: During the second quarter of fiscal year 2022, we changed our reporting segments to align our financial reporting with how we manage our business in strategic end markets. This is consistent with how our Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) assesses our financial performance and allocates resources. As a result, we report our financial performance based on the following four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.
